auth_subject.description:
Claimed identity. AuthSubject is always present; AuthIssuer is empty
until the gateway populates subject.claims on the webhook envelope.

principal_id.description: Resolved caller's UUID and kind; both absent when unresolved.

raw_usage.description:
RawUsage is the provider's usage block verbatim; null when the response
carried none. Token telemetry lives only here — the API does not parse
or normalize it.

next_cursor.description: NextCursor is passed back verbatim as the cursor query parameter.

code.description:
Code is the specific machine-readable reason within Type. Optional: a
message-only error omits it.

message.description: Message is the human-readable description, safe to show to the caller.

type.description:
Type is the broad class of the error. Optional: a message-only error
omits it.
